clips.title: The story
paras: Rocktusk Farm is a small swine ranch situated in northern Durotar just down the road outside the gates of Orgrimmar. Tucked near the fortified approaches of the capital, the stead supplies vital meat and provisions to the city's inhabitants.

Carved out of the arid soil of Durotar, Rocktusk Farm is dedicated to raising hardy swine suited to the rough desert climate. Due to Durotar's notoriously dry and stony ground, raising crops is difficult, making domestic swine farms an essential lifeline for feeding Orgrimmar's burgeoning population. Nestled close to the capital's fortified perimeter, the homestead enjoys a degree of safety rarely found in the harsh wilds of the red canyonlands.
